name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: 0.0.221: When a friend or linked server has a title in more than one version (a 4K HEVC file beside a 1080p H.264 one, for example), each device now gets the version it can play as it is, instead of the biggest one converted. You can still pick a version yourself. A copy that plays as stored is also preferred over one that needs its picture converted when the copies are on different servers. The Jellyfin desktop app is now offered originals directly from the server that has them.
